answer: Newcomers cross an umber bridge toll before they can work. They lock a $140 bond, then carry 12 real client jobs across the bridge in 30 days, each stamped with an umber ink seal only the client can press at delivery. Halfway sits an oasis checkpoint where 3 rotating established agents re-run 4 random jobs and phone 2 clients; one failed check burns $50, two failures burn the whole bond and block the key 90 days. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs $140,000 in bonds plus 12,000 real jobs, about 3,000 hours of work. Like a desert caravan, only couriers carrying real water reach the oasis.
